title: 第196章 倩舞和薇菀归心解秘辛初见符芙第195章 冷香引悟神符成寒牢重遇俏佳人
content_zh:
悦情给我解释了“磨魂钉”的底细——这是种高科技刑具。
它用到了维度技术，将一根根灵物锻铸的大头钉钉入头顶。
与众不同的是，钉尖朝外，钉头反倒嵌在头骨下方。
想正常拔出来，除非掀开头盖骨。
钉头那端紧贴着大脑皮层，哪怕极轻微的震动，都会刺激神经末梢引发剧烈痉挛，痛楚像电流似的瞬间窜遍全身。
脉搏跳动、肌肉抽搐，甚至痛极的嘶喊，都会让钉子震得更厉害，形成挣脱不开的恶性循环。
反倒痛得晕死过去后，没了嘶喊引发的不规则震动，痛感会减轻很多。
若是有科技设备辅助，精准锁定“磨魂钉”的位置，再掀开头盖骨取钉，并不算太难。
可要是没工具，想在不破坏头骨的前提下徒手取出来，根本是痴人说梦。
我现在就要帮符倩舞和荣薇菀取下“磨魂钉”。
我没工具，只能徒手来。
这话听着荒谬，对我而言却不算难事。
双耳升级后自带回声定位的能力，能在脑海里生成精细的三维结构图，让我清晰“看见”钉子嵌在头骨下的准确位置。
我给这双耳朵起了个名字，叫“万籁鉴影耳”——
只要震动或声音能传到我耳中，就能反向解析出物体的内部结构。
覆盖范围很广，和本初灵体小世界的范围相当。
距离越远，解析耗时越长，但精度丝毫不打折扣。
想精细扫出符倩舞和荣薇菀的头骨内部构造，只需要几秒。
取钉的法子也简单，用“塑形波”在头骨上塑形出一道道细缝，让钉子顺着缝隙滑出来，再塑形愈合就行。
动手前得让她们失去意识，免得乱动干扰塑形。

这也容易，持续放出“定身波”，她们就会保持僵直不动的状态。
几分钟后，她们的“磨魂钉”都顺利取了出来。
符倩舞的痛呼停了，荣薇菀也缓缓醒转。
两人望着我，眼神里一半是茫然，一半是劫后余生的庆幸。
这是个不错的开始。
接下来，就得说服她们跟我一起走。
……
总得先摸清她们的情况和意愿，再谈后续。
我抬手凝出一行字：“我有办法带你们逃出去，但前提是，你们得绝对信我。”
符倩舞和荣薇菀对视一眼，眼底还藏着惊疑。
“我从前就从这牢里逃出去过一次。”
话音刚落，我分出两道光影，分别飘进她们的牢房，同时本体在自己的囚室里隐去了身形。
两人眼中闪过一抹震撼，终于缓缓点了头。
“那就好，把你们的底细、看家的本事都说说。我能共享甚至放大你们的技能，帮咱们一起脱身。”
符倩舞深吸一口气，先凝出字迹：“我叫符倩舞，第八层木灵体，刚激活本命灵符没多久……”
她的本命灵符属治疗恢复类，能在护罩范围内将生命本源在不同个体间转移，既能给友方疗伤，也能抽走敌人的生机克敌。
她称其为“驭元流渡符”，简称“驭元符”。
这“驭元符”最玄妙的地方在于，哪怕一方已经化作枯骨，也能临时唤回生机，强行吊住一口气，让亡者说完最后的遗言、了却未尽的嘱托。
荣薇菀见状，也凝出一行字：“我叫荣薇菀，第六层木灵体，我的本命灵符能进行空间传送……”
她的本命灵符叫“灵晶遁空符”，简称“遁空符”。

传送靠消耗灵晶驱动，初始传送距离和本命灵符的护罩范围相当，所用灵晶每提升1级，传送距离就翻一倍。
“遁空符”最特别的地方，是可以选择非实时到达——
传送目标先进入一片临时空间，间隔一段时间后，再出现在范围内的任意指定地点。
content_en:
Yue Qing explained to me the details of the "Soul Grinding Nail" - it is a high-tech torture tool.
It used dimensional technology to drive tacks forged from spiritual objects into the top of the head.
What's unique is that the nail points are facing outward, and the nail head is embedded under the skull.
To pull it out normally, you have to lift the skull.
The end of the nail head is close to the cerebral cortex. Even the slightest vibration will stimulate the nerve endings and cause violent spasms. The pain will instantly course through the whole body like an electric current.
Pulse beating, muscle twitching, and even screams of pain will make the nails vibrate more violently, forming an inescapable vicious cycle.
On the contrary, after passing out from the pain, without the irregular vibrations caused by screaming, the pain will be reduced a lot.
If assisted by technological equipment, it would not be too difficult to accurately lock the position of the "soul-grinding nail" and then lift the skull to remove the nail.
But without tools, it would be impossible to take it out with bare hands without damaging the skull.
I will help Fu Qianwu and Rong Weiwan remove the "soul-grinding nails" now.
I had no tools, so I had to do it with my bare hands.
This sounds ridiculous, but it is not difficult for me.
The upgraded binaural capabilities have built-in echolocation capabilities, which can generate a detailed three-dimensional structural map in my mind, allowing me to clearly "see" the exact location of the nail embedded under the skull.
I gave these ears a name, "Wan Lai Jian Ying's ears"——
As long as vibration or sound can reach my ears, I can reversely analyze the internal structure of the object.
The coverage area is very wide, equivalent to the scope of the small world of the original spirit body.
The farther the distance, the longer the analysis takes, but the accuracy is not compromised at all.
It only takes a few seconds to scan out the internal structure of Fu Qianwu and Rong Weiwan's skulls in detail.
The method of removing the nails is also simple. Use "shaping waves" to shape thin slits on the skull, let the nails slide out along the gaps, and then reshape and heal.
They must lose consciousness before taking action, so as not to interfere with their shaping.
This is also easy. If you continue to release the "fixing wave", they will remain frozen and motionless.
After a few minutes, their "soul-grinding nails" were successfully taken out.
Fu Qianwu's cry of pain stopped, and Rong Weiwan slowly woke up.
The two of them looked at me, half in confusion and half in relief.
This is a good start.
Next, I have to convince them to come with me.
…
You must first find out their situation and wishes before discussing the follow-up.
I raised my hand and condensed a line of words: "I have a way to take you out, but the prerequisite is that you must absolutely trust me."
Fu Qianwu and Rong Weiwan looked at each other with surprise and doubt in their eyes.
"I've escaped from this prison once before."
As soon as I finished speaking, I separated two rays of light and shadow and floated into their cells respectively. At the same time, the main body disappeared in my own cell.
A flash of shock flashed in their eyes, and they finally nodded slowly.
"That's good, tell me your details and your special skills. I can share or even amplify your skills and help us escape together."
Fu Qianwu took a deep breath and wrote: "My name is Fu Qianwu. I am an eighth-level wood spirit body. I just activated my natal talisman not long ago..."
Her natal talisman is a healing and recovery type, which can transfer the source of life between different individuals within the shield range. It can not only heal allies, but also drain the enemy's vitality to defeat them.
She called it "Yuyuan Liudu Talisman", or "Yuyuan Talisman" for short.
The most mysterious thing about this "Yuan Yuan Talisman" is that even if one party has turned into withered bones, it can temporarily bring back life, forcibly holding a breath, so that the deceased can finish his last words and fulfill his unfinished instructions.
Seeing this, Rong Weiwan also condensed a line of words: "My name is Rong Weiwan, I am a sixth-level wood spirit body. My natal talisman can carry out space teleportation..."
Her natal spiritual talisman is called "Spiritual Crystal Escape Talisman", or "Escape Sky Talisman" for short.
The teleportation is driven by the consumption of spiritual crystals, and the initial teleportation distance is equivalent to the protective range of the natal talisman, soEvery time you level up with spiritual crystals, the teleportation distance doubles.
The most special thing about "Escape Talisman" is that you can choose to arrive in non-real time——
The teleportation target first enters a temporary space, and after a period of time, appears at any designated location within the range.
